> **DO NOT include real secrets, tokens, or production customer PII in this issue.**

## Vulnerability Category
- [ ] Cross-Tenant Data Access (IDOR / RLS bypass)
- [ ] Privilege Escalation (RBAC bypass)
- [ ] Booking Concurrency / Capacity Bypass
- [ ] Financial Ledger Tampering
- [ ] Public Endpoint Sensitive Field Exposure

## Description & Reproduction
Provide step-by-step instructions to verify the issue using demo tenants (`RAVAN Demo Travel` / `Zagros Horizon Tours`).
